entities.summary: High Growth and Economic Miracle, a transformative movement in Japan (1955–1989). Emerged from New Japanese Constitution enacted — includes pacifist Article 9 and Allied Occupation and Reform. Catalyzed Tokyo Olympics and Tōkaidō Shinkansen bullet train launch and Japan becomes the world's second-largest economy.
